common.bridge_ready_title: TentAHAcle - Virtual Device Bridge is ready
common.bridge_ready_message: Open **Settings → Devices & services → TentAHAcle - Virtual Device Bridge** and use the **+** in the top-right corner to add a virtual FRITZ! device. Then open [FRITZ!OS]({fritz_url}) to assign or configure it.
common.device_created_message: **{fritz_name}** has been created. Open [FRITZ!OS]({fritz_url}) now to assign or configure the virtual device. Add more virtual devices through the **+** in the top-right corner of the bridge entry.

user.title: Connect an MQTT bridge
user.description: Use the same bridge ID configured in the Freetz package.

reconfigure.title: Configure bridge
reconfigure.description: The FRITZ!Box URL opens the Smart Home interface used to assign and configure virtual devices.

mqtt_confirm.title: Add discovered bridge
mqtt_confirm.description: Connect the discovered TentAHAcle - Virtual Device Bridge {bridge_id}.

error.invalid_bridge_id: Use 3–32 lowercase letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens.
error.invalid_fritz_url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS URL without credentials or query parameters.
error.invalid_topic_root: Enter an MQTT prefix without spaces, empty segments or +/# (at most 255 UTF-8 bytes including the bridge ID).

abort.invalid_discovery: The MQTT bridge announcement is invalid or unsupported.

user.title: Add virtual device
user.description: Choose the Home Assistant entity to represent as a virtual FRITZ! device.

details.title: Confirm virtual device
details.description: The best matching profile is selected automatically. If you prefer another profile, select it here manually. In the next step, you can assign or configure the virtual device in the FRITZ!OS interface.

reconfigure.title: Rebind virtual device
reconfigure.description: Changing the source entity or name keeps the FRITZ identity and existing assignments.

create_entry.default: **{fritz_name}** was created successfully. Open the [FRITZ!OS interface]({fritz_url}) now to assign or configure the virtual device.

error.already_mapped: This Home Assistant entity already has a virtual FRITZ device on this bridge.
error.incompatible_cover: Choose a cover that supports both opening and closing, either directly or through numeric positioning.
error.incompatible_thermostat: Choose a thermostat that provides the target-temperature, heat/off, range and step controls required by this bridge (including 8–28 °C and half-degree-compatible steps).
error.incompatible_profile: The entity does not support this persistent FRITZ profile.
error.invalid_name: Enter a name without leading or trailing spaces and containing at most 79 UTF-8 bytes.
error.source_entity_missing: The selected Home Assistant entity does not exist.

abort.source_entity_missing: The selected Home Assistant entity no longer exists.
abort.incompatible_cover: The selected cover cannot implement both FRITZ open and close controls.
abort.incompatible_thermostat: The selected thermostat cannot implement the thermostat controls required by this bridge.
abort.device_limit_reached: This bridge has reached the current limit of 64 virtual devices.
